notes: The baseline surface uses one shared LLaDA denoising rollout with paper-backed cache-plan mechanisms mapped onto common hooks, not a menu of black-box backends.
Tests use benchmark-native final scores on MATH-500, HumanEval, and ARC-Challenge/lm-eval style workloads.

baselines.name: d2cache

baselines.name: elastic_cache
baselines.notes: Official Elastic-Cache tracked-token and attention-similarity reset mechanism mapped onto the shared cache-plan hooks.
